blocks.text: Having enough money to buy anything in a department store sounds nice. Having so much that you don’t bother to check the price tags sounds even better. That fantasy is at the heart of “Hyunbaek-core,” a fashion trend circulating on social media that draws on the image of an affluent young woman browsing Hyundai Department Store in clothes that look simple but expensive. The style is understated yet polished, built around well-cut basics, subtle accessories and discreet luxury labels. She makes looking expensive look easy, as though she has little else to think about besides where to have coffee that afternoon. […]...
